note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Axios interview: Sam Altman's sobering siren
items.blurb: Altman says the next model generation will be "sobering" and that alignment progress will now pace releases.

items.title: OpenAI begins rolling out Astra model after warning of its advanced cyber capabilities
items.blurb: GPT-6 Astra ships in phases, starting with vetted Daybreak security customers before ChatGPT paid tiers, the API and AWS.

items.title: OpenAI releases new model GPT-6 Astra, says it may represent AGI
items.blurb: OpenAI positions Astra as a milestone in its AGI push; president Greg Brockman calls it the start of the AGI era.

items.title: Altman raises stakes on government scrutiny as AI advances
items.blurb: Altman calls the administration's voluntary Astra review productive and says Congress still lacks a basic frontier-AI framework.

items.title: Scaling agentic AI pilots across the enterprise
items.blurb: Roughly 80% of Fortune 500 firms have adopted agentic AI, but most remain stuck in isolated pilots rather than production scale.

items.title: Reply to: Limited benchmarks constrain the conclusions of a general-purpose versus clinical AI comparison
items.blurb: Nature Medicine exchange over whether general-purpose models genuinely outperform purpose-built clinical AI on real clinical queries.

items.title: Hidden China risks are emerging in America's multibillion-dollar AI data center boom
items.blurb: Chinese-made transformers, switchgear and batteries sit deep in the US data-center power stack as capacity heads toward 152 GW.

items.title: Meta settlement could clear the way for new AI product launches, Morgan Stanley says
items.blurb: Analysts say Meta's $18 billion settlement removes a legal overhang that had delayed several consumer AI product launches.

items.title: G20 live updates: White House readying tariffs on semiconductors, Lutnick tells CNBC
items.blurb: Nvidia's Huang, Musk and Treasury's Bessent debate AI benefits and data-center backlash as semiconductor tariffs are prepared.

items.title: AI trade faces test with next week's Oracle earnings
items.blurb: Oracle results will test investor conviction in AI infrastructure spending and OpenAI's large compute commitments to the company.

items.title: The Download: AI puzzles and a path to our nearest star system
items.blurb: Daily research roundup covering puzzle-based AI reasoning evaluation and an interstellar mission concept.

items.title: Meta debuts Muse Spark 1.3 as personal agent work continues
items.blurb: Meta's third Muse Spark refresh in five weeks claims large coding and long-context gains at unchanged pricing.

items.title: Trump's AI team fractures over strategy against G20 backdrop
items.blurb: Commerce and White House tech policy staff split on AI strategy as the G20 innovation ministerial convenes.

items.title: AI frenzy means that debt can be interest free
items.blurb: Investors accepted $186.8B of convertible bonds this year, roughly 60% AI-linked, some at zero coupon.

items.title: How AI is playing a growing role in wildfire response
items.blurb: Detection and monitoring models are moving toward helping officials allocate crews across simultaneous fires.

items.title: Google starts September with AI momentum after longest monthly losing streak in over a decade
items.blurb: Gemini 3.8 Flash and a cyber-tier model follow Alphabet's worst monthly stock run in over ten years.

items.title: Snowflake spikes 22% on healthy results and AI coding momentum
items.blurb: Data platform's growth is credited partly to adoption of its AI coding agent, a concrete enterprise revenue signal.

items.title: Dell has more than tripled in 2026. Two analysts say it has more room to run after earnings
items.blurb: Dell is up 238% year-to-date on AI server demand, showing the buildout reaching legacy hardware vendors.

items.title: Exclusive: Aitan, battle-tested by IDF, raises $41 million
items.blurb: Physical-AI robotics startup exits stealth with Dell Technologies Capital backing, extending AI investment beyond software.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic aim to balance safety, progress as IPOs near
items.blurb: Both labs must convince investors of growth while assuring regulators their models are contained.

items.title: How Equinix has found a niche in the multitrillion-dollar AI data center boom
items.blurb: Colocation operator partners with Nvidia, showing how the buildout is pulling in firms beyond the hyperscalers.

items.title: Anthropic changes data retention policy after pushback from customers
items.blurb: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 alongside Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, giving business customers control over data review and storage.

items.title: AI token prices are hitting new record lows
items.blurb: Inference costs keep falling as cheap Chinese open-weight models such as Moonshot's Kimi K3 undercut US frontier lab pricing.

items.title: Apple, OpenAI lawsuit timeline: How the legal fight keeps escalating
items.blurb: OpenAI's latest filing argues Apple failed to protect itself; a judge hears the escalating device-and-model dispute Oct 1.
